summary.headline: Eclipses, Earthquakes, and Stellar Omens
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Florentine astrological codex cover planetary twelfth-parts, eclipses, earthquakes, comets, zodiacal signs, Dog-star risings, and stellar phenomena producing winds, sea disturbances, rain, and fair weather. Authorities and parallels include Hephaestion, Symeon the monk, the Geoponica, Clodius’s Calendar, Paulus Alexandrinus, and Wachsmuth’s editions.
